outcome:
## Why

PR #34 (lance-db ESM fix) was merged without a `release:patch` label so no npm publish fired. We need a way to trigger a patch release without opening another dummy PR.

## What

Adds `workflow_dispatch` to `auto-release.yml` with a `bump_type` input (patch / minor / major, default: patch).

- **Merging this PR** (with the `release:patch` label below) publishes v3.3.1 — covering the lance-db fix from PR #34
- **Going forward**, any future unlabelled merge can be recovered with: _Actions
